purpose: Twenty-task development calibration with expanded call allowance
sampling: provider defaults; no cross-provider seed equivalence
ordering: task blocks; seeded deterministic arm/provider order; at most two independent tasks concurrently
billingLimitNote: Between-trial stop, not a provider billing hard cap. Current in-flight usage may be unknown.
exclusions: Calibration only; no dropped model failures or automatic retries. Exclude these tasks from later held-out claims. No broad superiority or narrow noninferiority inference.
selection: Metadata-only convenience sample; existing solver repository/version profiles; excludes previously selected task IDs. Not representative.
controlPolicy: Before paid calls, require native gold/oracle pass and Terminal-Bench no-op fail. Preserve control failures; do not silently replace selected tasks.
budgetNote: Observed-cost dispatch stop, not a provider hard cap; at most two in-flight trials can incur additional cost. Stop dispatch on incomplete accounting; retain all outcomes.
